text: Meet Get Paid — an autonomous accounts-receivable agent built for freelancers. You just paste any casual client message, and the agent reads it, scopes out the line items, and drafts a PayPal invoice in seconds.

Once that invoice goes out, the agent watches the due date for you. If a client runs late, it sends escalating, professional follow-ups on its own — friendly at first, then firmer — and it can even pause deliverables to protect your time.
It runs on live PayPal rails, monitoring payment webhooks around the clock — collecting for you even when your computer is switched off.
A built-in AI assistant lets you ask about any invoice, client, or payment, in plain English.
Under the hood it's a clear, five-step pipeline — bill, watch, chase, and ask — so every action the agent takes is fully auditable.
The whole experience is designed to get freelancers paid faster, with zero awkward chasing.
Let's step inside the app. This is your accounts-receivable command center.
The invoices view shows everything at a glance — total outstanding, settled volume, and which accounts are overdue — with one-click actions to chase a client or mark them paid.
Analytics break down your cash flow and collection performance over time, so you always know where your money stands.
The AI copilot answers financial questions and can take action on your behalf, right from the dashboard.
And the clients directory keeps every payer, along with their full payment history, in one organized place.
